quality.label: Strong Starter
quality.explanation: Evaluated as a midfielder: key passes and xA per 90 (creativity) plus interceptions + tackles won per 90 (defensive work), ranked against Bundesliga players in the same position group with 450+ minutes this season. Doesn't account for team style or opposition quality -- a low score can reflect a team's system as much as individual quality.
